param: RD_LAT: scalar int (all banks) or contract LIST [l0..l7] (element b = bank vmb_<q>b), emitted packed {8d l7,...,8d l0}
semantics: l_b = registers rq pin -> bank b -> rr pin = 6 + faces pin 1 + lane_rq_b + lane_rr_b (d4g_bank_latency RT_b, ref 6 at RT 6). ctl issues bank b request D_b = max(l) - l_b edges after the wave issue from one shared 16-bit tapped delay line; all answers land together max(l) edges after issue; everything after rr pins (md, em_off, eg_*, x_done) = the scalar schedule at RD_LAT = max(l).
decision: ONE hardened view for all four quadrants: RD_LAT = BUDGET = element-wise max over quadrants + 4 edges GEN2d headroom; die pads the rq2 (17-bit request) lane of each bank by budget - RT_b. No rr (257-bit) padding anywhere.

compare.scalar_rr_pad_note: padding the rr side instead costs 257 b per edge (15x)
compare.per_quadrant_exact_vectors: 0 die pads but 4 hardened ctlx views (E/W pair split: 2 views, ~150 pad edges)

tile_cost: md metadata line 8 -> 57 stages x 21 b (+1,029 flops) + issue stagger line 28 x 16 b (448 flops) + 8 per-lane 12-b +1 adders; datapath unchanged
schedule: x-load first beat / every xw beat / x_done +49 edges vs RD_LAT 6 (= scalar schedule at 55); command calendar spacing (issuer at) must allow it. VM calendar: x-load read of bank b reaches its port D_b + lane_rq_b + pad_b = 55 - 7 - lane_rr_b edges after the wave issue (rslot of the x-load group).
headroom_rule: GEN2d: if any bank RT_b > budget_b the view must be re-hardened; otherwise the die re-pads rq2 only (re-run d4g_bank_latency: lane_pads).
